dare: Send the group a selfie making your silliest face.
Do 10 jumping jacks right now and describe how it went.
Speak in a fake accent for the next three messages.
Text your most-used emoji 5 times in a row and explain why it's that one.
Compliment the person above you with an over-the-top speech.
Try to lick your elbow. Report the scientific results.
Sing the chorus of your favorite song using only the word 'meow'.
Balance a spoon on your nose for 10 seconds (or try!).
Do your best impression of a robot until your next message.
Say the alphabet backwards as fast as you can, then time yourself.
Let the group pick your profile picture for the next hour (screenshot optional).
Make up a short poem about the last thing you ate.
Talk like a news anchor and 'report' on what's happening around you.
Hold a plank for 20 seconds and share the verdict.
Answer the next question you're asked with a question.
Draw a self-portrait in 30 seconds without lifting your finger (send a photo).
Tell a joke so bad that it circles back to funny.
Wear your shirt backwards for the next 15 minutes.
Call someone and sing 'Happy Birthday' — even if it's nobody's birthday.
Speak only in questions for the next 5 minutes.
Do your best evil laugh and record it.
Make up a dramatic soap-opera scene using a banana as a prop (or mime one).
Tell everyone the last thing in your search history that you're comfortable sharing.
Stretch like a cat for 15 seconds. Describe the inner peace.
Reply to the next message using only song lyrics.
Give yourself a dramatic movie-trailer narration of your day so far.
Learn to say 'hello' in 3 languages and demonstrate.
Make the weirdest sound effect with your voice and commit to it.
Pick a book or object nearby and give it a 30-second infomercial.
Do 5 minutes of your best dance moves (description or video — your choice).
